trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies. This is the final reward for a full Leonida playthrough, so expect roughly 200 hours from the opening mission to the last collectible. Work through the story, side strands, activities and collectibles methodically, and remember that cheats disable trophies, so keep them off for the whole run.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Play through the opening mission, Gone Fishing, until its closing scene. This is the first story mission of the game and unlocks automatically as you follow the on-screen objectives. Nothing here can be missed, so just enjoy the introduction to Leonida.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Complete every mission in Chapter 1 to close the chapter. Follow the story markers on the map and finish each objective in order. The trophy pops the moment the chapter's final cutscene ends.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish all of Chapter 2's story missions. The chapter builds on the opening arc, so keep following the main story markers and complete each mission as it appears. The trophy unlocks when the chapter-closing scene plays.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3 in full. By now the map is opening up, but the trophy only needs the story missions, so push the main quest line forward. It pops as soon as the chapter ends.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4's story missions to close the chapter. Expect tougher shootouts and driving sections as the story escalates. The trophy unlocks at the chapter's final scene.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of the story. This is the last main story beat, so finish every chapter before it and arrive prepared with upgraded weapons and armor. The trophy pops when the credits roll, and it also counts toward the platinum.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. It appears on the main story path, so keep playing through the chapters until the marker shows up. Follow the objectives to the end of the mission and the trophy unlocks automatically.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. This is a big set-piece mission on the main path, so stock up on ammo and armor before starting. Finish the heist's final objective and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. The mission unlocks as part of the main story, so just keep advancing the chapters. Complete its objectives and the trophy is yours.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. It sits on the main story path, so play through the chapters until the marker appears. Finish the mission and the trophy unlocks.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown. This airport mission unlocks through the main story, so keep pushing the chapters forward. Complete the takedown and the trophy pops at the mission's end.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. It is a late-story mission, so work through the chapters until it appears. Finish the operation's final objective to unlock the trophy.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion across the whole game. That means finishing the story, all stranger strands, activities, collectibles and side objectives tracked in the pause menu. It is the longest single trophy in the list, so treat it as the final push of your roughly 200-hour platinum run.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts across Leonida. Stunts trigger from jumps, near misses, airtime, drifts and other driving feats, so they build up naturally during free roam, races and story driving. To speed it up, find a ramp or hill jump in a fast car and chain airtime with near misses on a busy road, then check the stunt counter in the stats menu to track your progress.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. The activities include races, fishing, the shooting range, drone races, arcade games, bowling and more, all marked on the map. Sample one of each and the trophy pops; you do not need to win or master any of them.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Visit the shooting range and work through every challenge, aiming for the gold score threshold on each. Use a steady weapon with good accuracy, take your time between shots, and retry any challenge until gold lands.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations. Each location hosts its own drone race, so travel the map and enter each one. Learn the gates and shortcuts on a practice run, then race clean to take first place at all 14 spots.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Races are scattered across Leonida, from street circuits to off-road tracks, and each distinct race counts once. Pick a fast, well-handling car, learn the corners, and work through the race markers until 20 wins are banked.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find the fishing challenge marker and take Cal on at his own game. Use the right bait for the spot, keep your line tension steady, and reel in the bigger catch to win.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Head to an arcade, pick any cabinet, and play it through to its end. You do not need a high score, just a full completion, so choose the shortest game on offer.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy's mission strand opens during the story, so keep checking for his markers between main missions. Finish his last job and the trophy unlocks.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Kenton's strand appears as you progress, so follow his markers when they show up on the map. Complete his closing mission to earn the trophy.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Billy's missions unlock through the story, so take them as they appear. Finish his final ride and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida. Stranger markers appear all over the map as you explore, each with its own short story arc of several missions. Work through any 8 full strands, from first meeting to final mission, and the trophy pops when the eighth strand closes.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Randy's strand unlocks during the story, so watch for his markers. Finish his last mission and the trophy is yours.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Tyrone's missions appear as the story moves forward, so take them when they show. Complete his final job to unlock the trophy.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every one of the 18 meditation spots across Leonida. This is the game's ONLY missable trophy: there is no mission replay, so if you finish the story without visiting all 18 spots, the trophy is locked for that playthrough. Use the 15 manual save slots to keep a safety save before the final missions, and sweep the spots early with a map checklist so none is left behind.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunting strand points you to a rare animal somewhere in Leonida's wilds. Track it with the hunting markers, take a clean shot, and bring the trophy home.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Card packs and loose cards are hidden all over Leonida, so collect them as you explore and check your collection menu. Finish any 3 full sets to unlock the trophy.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. The WAiNK It photo spots are spread across the whole map, so snap one at every marked location you pass. It adds up fast if you photograph each new spot as you travel rather than backtracking later.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges cover driving, combat, exploration, stealth and more, and they tick over in the background as you play through the story and side content. Open the challenges menu regularly to see which ones are close, then mop up the easy ones first, like distance driven, enemies defeated or areas visited, until 50 are done.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Build up a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then break line of sight and stay out of the search cones until the stars clear. A fast car and the back roads of Leonida make the escape much easier.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Hit one shop, keep the wanted level alive, and immediately rob two more in a row while your partner is alongside. Plan a route with three close shops and a getaway car ready outside.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. New vehicles count the first time you enter or spot them, so drive everything you see, from sedans to supercars. Check the vehicle log to see how many are left, and cruise car-heavy areas like Vice City to finish the list.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Activate Combat Focus during a firefight with a group of enemies close together. Line up your shots quickly while time slows and drop five before the focus ends; a crowded shootout is the best place to try.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Head to Vice City International Airport and find a way out of the airport that is not a scheduled flight. The trophy pops once you leave the airfield on your own terms.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Deal with the Rhinos, the military tanks that roll in once your wanted level climbs high enough. Push your wanted level up in open ground where you can see them coming, then hit them with heavy weapons like sticky explosives or a rocket launcher. Survive the encounter and deal with the tanks, and the trophy unlocks.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Case a jewelry store, wait for a quiet moment, and get in and out without raising the alarm. Move slowly, avoid the cameras and guards, and leave before anyone notices.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Bank vault robberies are bigger jobs, so plan each one with armor, ammo and a fast getaway car. Hit five different vaults and get clear of the police each time to unlock the trophy.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Find an armored truck on the roads of Leonida, hit it hard, grab the cash, and lose the wanted level. A quiet stretch of highway and a fast car make the escape simple.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. The map is divided into 52 areas, and each one counts once you have visited it. Drive, fly or sail through every region, from Vice City to the swamps, and the trophy pops when the last area is discovered.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. There are 9 gangs running illegal operations across Leonida, so hit one operation per gang. Scout each location first, then rob it and escape to tick that gang off the list.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to the Ocean Beach bar area and order a cocktail at the right spot overlooking the water. Sit back, take in the view, and the trophy pops as the moment lands.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Find a vehicle showroom, get inside a car, and drive straight out through the glass in the most dramatic way possible. The trophy unlocks once you burst out onto the street.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Visit the bowling alley and play a full game, following through on your shots. You do not need a perfect score, just a completed game at that alley.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. This story-linked trophy unlocks as your partnership reaches a crowd-pleasing high point. Keep playing the main story and the moment arrives on its own; there is nothing extra to grind.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse. Some story moments ask you to make a choice, and this trophy tracks those decisions. Play through the story and make your calls; the trophy pops once the tracked choices are complete.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. Fail once at something the game tracks, then succeed on the very next try. It unlocks naturally during a long playthrough, so do not force it; just keep playing and it will come.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? Something strange is out there in Leonida, and this trophy is for witnessing it. Explore the odd corners of the map, follow strange markers and events, and the moment will find you.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. While driving past a pedestrian, swing a melee weapon from the vehicle to knock them down. A slow drive-by on a quiet street makes the timing easy.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists, and your contacts will clean them for a cut. Keep laundering through the contact network until $250,000 is washed.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Money spent in any shop counts, from clothes and weapons to food and cars. Just play normally and buy what you need, and the total will cross $100,000 well before the platinum.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. There are 8 garage properties for sale across Leonida, so save up and buy each one. Owning them all also gives you storage across the map, and the trophy pops on the final purchase.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Open the Scooter Bros app on your phone and register vehicles you own or find. Ten registrations later, the trophy unlocks.
trophies.name: On the Spot
